title: UCB1 for Multi-Armed Bandits
seoDescription: In a multi-armed bandit, an agent must repeatedly choose one of K arms and only observes the reward of the arm it pulls.
description:
Select optimal arms in a multi-armed bandit balancing empirical mean reward with logarithmic uncertainty bonuses.

UCB1 provably achieves logarithmic cumulative regret by systematically sampling under-explored arms.

### Mathematical Formulation
$$
a^* = \arg\max_a \left[ \hat{\mu}_a + c \sqrt{\frac{2 \ln t}{N_a(t)}} \right]
$$

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Compute empirical sample mean reward for each candidate arm
2. Calculate exploration bonus proportional to sqrt(2 ln(t) / N_a)
3. Select arm maximizing combined upper confidence bound score

### Returns
Dictionary with 'best_arm' index and 'ucb_scores'.
